description:
A restaurant has just been acquired and rebranded. You need to update the restaurant's configuration information in the Floreant POS system.

The Floreant POS application is open and showing the main terminal screen.

Navigate to the Back Office (use PIN: 1111), then find the restaurant configuration settings and update the following fields:

- Restaurant Name: Bayview Grill & Taphouse
- Address Line 1: 782 Shoreline Boulevard
- Zip Code: 94301
- Telephone: 6508520194

After entering all four fields, save the changes.

Note: You may need to clear existing values in each field before typing the new ones.
